title: Root-n Precision for Treatment Effects on Mean Latent Subject Richness
banked_reason: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope. Fresh validity gate confirms math-panel PASS and discloses unrepaired closest-prior positioning; moving-gap precision is a new theorem program.
gap_reasons: Delivered tier incremental < floor field; not salvageable within scope.
The delivered results establish the root-n iff and the capacity-two logarithmic coefficient, but provide no matching quantitative precision curve across moving gaps.

Position the claimed exact logarithmic endpoint frontier against Klaassen--Mnatsakanov (2020), which gives an optimal logarithmic-rate Laplace/factorial-moment inversion result for an iid univariate Poisson mixing distribution; state theorem-level distinctions (endpoint-richness functional, marked unit-sum simplex experiment, shrinking gap, and exact exponent) rather than relying on broad NPMLE comparisons.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived the arbitrary-capacity root-n iff boundary and the fixed-gap capacity-two logarithmic exponent, with public whole-parent honest procedures. The math panel passed after original-source Hoeffding attestation, but the normalized incremental tier and score ceiling 5.6 did not meet the field floor; closest-prior positioning remains unrepaired. Formalization was not started: these are informal derivations, with no Lean verification or accepted-bank claim; moving-gap matching precision requires a separately scoped re-raise.
tldr: An intervention can alter the mean true richness of individual subjects even when pooled taxa and mean composition do not change. Bounded assays imperfectly measure that outcome. The proposed results characterize uniform root-n precision on the entire arbitrary-composition mixture class: it is attainable exactly when the public gap collapses to one half at some polynomial enrollment rate. At fixed positive continuum width and capacity two, the exact leading logarithmic coefficient is determined by isolated-endpoint approximation and Poisson factorial inversion. All confidence statements concern finite honest connected intervals in the original patient experiment.
gap: Common-composition support estimation and abstract mixture-functional duality do not supply the explicit moving-class precision boundary for mean subject richness. A lower witness must preserve unit sum and the public gap while maintaining normalized separation as capacity grows.
fill: Theorems 2 and 3 pair explicit public count-score attainment with full-patient all-procedure converses. Open-ended Question 1 exposes the unresolved construction and certification work. The contribution is the explicit inverse problem at bounded depth, with achievable ambition confined to a specialist subfield result.
